lines.t: Verse 1
The city fades when the shadow falls,
I hear my breath in the empty halls,
Hands on my chest like a steady flame,
Still You know me when I cannot say Your name,
I’ve been walking through the afterglow,
A tired soul in the undertow,
Everything loud, but my heart stays still,
Waiting on mercy in a broken will.
Pre-Chorus
And I don’t have words,
Only this ache,
But You are here,
Even in the wait.
Chorus
Hold me in the silence of the Sabbath,
When my strength runs low and my faith is shattered,
I feel lost, but I’m not abandoned,
You are close in the quiet I can’t understand,
Lay me down in the peace of Your shadow,
Where the dark can’t touch what Your love has gathered,
I’m not whole, but I’m held in the cracks,
Breathe on my soul in the silence of the Sabbath.
Breathe on my soul in the silence of the Sabbath.
Verse 2
Midnight leans in like a heavy rain,
Every old wound saying I’m not the same,
But there’s a stillness under all this pain,
Like a holy whisper calling me again,
If I’ve been wandering through a valley blind,
You’re the Shepherd walking right behind,
No, I don’t see far, but I trust Your hand,
Even in the dark I can barely stand.
Pre-Chorus
And I don’t need light
To know You’re near,
Your love is enough
To pull me here.
Chorus
Hold me in the silence of the Sabbath,
When my strength runs low and my faith is shattered,
I feel lost, but I’m not abandoned,
You are close in the quiet I can’t understand,
Lay me down in the peace of Your shadow,
Where the dark can’t touch what Your love has gathered,
I’m not whole, but I’m held in the cracks,
Breathe on my soul in the silence of the Sabbath.
Bridge
So let the night fall soft,
Let the noise all fade away,
I was made to rest in You,
Not to carry every weight,
If my tears are all I bring,
Still You call it an offering,
In the hush, in the wait,
You are God, You remain.
Final Chorus
Hold me in the silence of the Sabbath,
When my strength runs low and my faith is shattered,
I feel lost, but I’m not abandoned,
You are close in the quiet I can’t understand,
Lay me down in the peace of Your shadow,
Where the dark can’t touch what Your love has gathered,
I’m not whole, but I’m held in the cracks,
Breathe on my soul in the silence of the Sabbath.
Outro
In the silence, You stay,
In the dark, You remain,
I am held, I am held,
By the God of the Sabbath.
